cards.ex: To my mind, the benefits of this policy outweigh the risks.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, bu siyosatning foydalari xavflardan ustun turadi.
cards.uzDef: "Men o'ylaymanki" yoki "mening fikrimcha" degan ma'noni anglatadi.

cards.ex: I get your point, but I still don't agree with your conclusion.
cards.exUz: Sizning fikringizni tushundim, lekin men hali ham xulosangizga qo'shilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir fikrini yoki argumentini tushunishni bildiradi.

cards.ex: I'm willing to compromise, but I draw the line at lying.
cards.exUz: Men murosaga tayyorman, lekin yolg'on gapirishga chegara qo'yaman.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan chegarani belgilash.

cards.ex: I've got a bone to pick with you about the way you handled that situation.
cards.exUz: Siz bilan vaziyatni qanday hal qilganingiz haqida gaplashadigan gapim bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida shikoyat qilish sababi.

cards.ex: The main sticking point in the negotiations is still the salary.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralarda asosiy bahsli nuqta hali ham maoshdir.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishishga to'sqinlik qiladigan asosiy muammo.

cards.ex: On the face of it, the proposal seems reasonable, but we need to investigate further.
cards.exUz: Qaraganda, taklif o'rinli ko'rinadi, lekin biz uni yanada o'rganishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi qarashda, tashqi tomondan ko'rinishicha.

cards.ex: His argument begs the question of how we define 'success'.
cards.exUz: Uning argumenti 'muvaffaqiyat'ni qanday ta'riflashimiz savolini tug'diradi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob berilishi kerak bo'lgan savolni keltirib chiqaradi.

cards.ex: For all I know, he might be telling the truth, but I doubt it.
cards.exUz: Bilmadim, u rost gapirayotgan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin men bunga shubha qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Men aniq bilmayman degan ma'noni bildiradi.

cards.ex: That's a fallacious argument because it relies on personal attacks rather than facts.
cards.exUz: Bu xato argument, chunki u faktlardan ko'ra shaxsiy hujumlarga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqiy xatoga asoslangan argument.

cards.ex: We need to improve our communication skills, and to that end, we're organizing a workshop.
cards.exUz: Biz aloqa ko'nikmalarimizni yaxshilashimiz kerak va shu maqsadda biz seminar tashkil qilmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Shu maqsadga erishish uchun.

cards.ex: Just because he's rich doesn't necessarily mean he's happy.
cards.exUz: U boy bo'lgani uchun uning baxtli ekanligi shart emas.
cards.uzDef: Bunday bo'lishi shart emas degan ma'noni anglatadi.

cards.ex: Everyone's jumping on the bandwagon and supporting that candidate, but I'm not so sure.
cards.exUz: Hamma trendga qo'shilib, o'sha nomzodni qo'llab-quvvatlamoqda, lekin men unchalik amin emasman.
cards.uzDef: Ommabop bo'lgan narsani qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: I'm just playing devil's advocate here, but have you considered the potential drawbacks?
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki qarshilar advokatini o'ynamoqdaman, lekin siz potentsial kamchiliklarni ko'rib chiqdingizmi?
cards.uzDef: Argumentga qarshi chiqib, munozarani rag'batlantiruvchi.

cards.ex: We've argued about this for hours, I guess we'll just have to agree to disagree.
cards.exUz: Biz bu haqda soatlab bahslashdik, menimcha, shunchaki kelishmaslikka kelishamiz.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlarda farq borligini tan olish va munozarani to'xtatish.

cards.ex: You should take his advice with a grain of salt; he's not always right.
cards.exUz: Siz uning maslahatini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak; u har doim ham haq emas.
cards.term: take it with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: To'liq ishonmasdan, shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The company's performance has been poor, especially in that regard.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning faoliyati yomon bo'ldi, ayniqsa shu jihatdan.
cards.uzDef: Bu nuqtai nazardan yoki shu xususda.

cards.ex: Technology is a double-edged sword; it can improve our lives, but it can also create new problems.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama qilichdir; u hayotimizni yaxshilashi mumkin, lekin u yangi muammolarni ham yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ham foydali, ham zarali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I was going to order pizza, but on second thought, I think I'll make pasta.
cards.exUz: Men pizza buyurmoqchi edim, lekin o'ylab ko'rib, makaron tayyorlashga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Yana o'ylab ko'rib, fikringizni o'zgartirganingizda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: I think you're missing the point; it's not about the money, it's about the principle.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz mohiyatni tushunmayapsiz; gap pulda emas, gap prinsipda.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy g'oyani yoki argumentni tushunmaslik.

cards.ex: That's a fair point; I hadn't thought about it that way.
cards.exUz: Bu haqiqiy fikr; Men bu haqda o'ylamagan edim.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri va o'rinli fikr.

cards.ex: To be frank, I don't think your plan will work.
cards.exUz: Ochig'ini aytsam, men sizning rejangiz ish beradi deb o'ylamayman.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va to'g'ri gapirishni ko'rsatadi.

cards.ex: In all fairness, he did warn us about the risks.
cards.exUz: Adolat yuzasidan, u bizni xavflar haqida ogohlantirgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va xolis bo'lishni ko'rsatadi.

cards.ex: We need to take a stand against injustice and inequality.
cards.exUz: Biz adolatsizlik va tengsizlikka qarshi pozitsiya egallashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa uchun ochiqchasiga pozitsiyani egallash.

cards.ex: Choosing between these two options is like choosing the lesser of two evils.
cards.exUz: Bu ikki variantni tanlash yomonlarning yengilini tanlashga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yomon variantdan eng yaxshisini tanlash.

cards.ex: Just hear me out before you make a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin meni eshitib ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: Fikringizni oxirigacha eshitishni so'rash.

cards.ex: The law is a bit of a grey area on this particular issue.
cards.exUz: Qonun bu masalada biroz noaniq sohadir.
cards.uzDef: Aniqlik yo'q bo'lgan vaziyat yoki mavzu.

cards.ex: I have reservations about his ability to lead the team.
cards.exUz: Menda uning jamoani boshqarish qobiliyatiga shubhalar bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida shubhalar yoki xavotirlar bo'lishi.

cards.ex: To put it bluntly, your performance has been unacceptable.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri aytsam, sizning ishlashingiz qoniqarsiz bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va to'g'ri gapirishni ko'rsatadi, lekin ehtiyotkorlik bilan emas.

cards.ex: The two countries are very similar in this respect.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat shu ma'noda juda o'xshash.
cards.uzDef: Bu jihatdan yoki shu nuqtai nazardan.

cards.ex: Okay, I'll get off my soapbox now. I just feel strongly about this issue.
cards.exUz: Xo'p, men endi ma'ruza o'qishni bas qilaman. Men bu masala haqida juda qayg'uraman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida uzoq va qizg'in gapirishni to'xtatish.
